stories.title: India–UK CETA comes into force on 15 July 2026
stories.body: the "gold standard" free trade deal under which the UK eliminates or reduces tariffs on 98.8% of its tariff lines; the Double Contribution Convention (DCC) also takes effect.

one_liners: India–UK CETA comes into force on 15 July 2026 — the "gold standard" free trade deal under which the UK eliminates or reduces tariffs on 98.8% of its tariff lines
